from pathlib import Path
import json,bisect,collections,re
prior=json.loads(Path('docs/performance/unresolved-roots-cpu-20261006.json').read_text());out=[]
for run in prior['runs']:
 p=Path(run['rawPerfPath']).parent;table={}
 for line in (p/'managed-perf.map').read_text().splitlines():
  a=line.split(' ',2)
  if len(a)==3:table[int(a[0],16)]=(int(a[0],16)+int(a[1],16),a[2])
 addresses=sorted(table)
 def resolve(pc):
  i=bisect.bisect_right(addresses,pc)-1
  return table[addresses[i]][1] if i>=0 and pc<table[addresses[i]][0] else ''
 samples=cycles=0;counter=collections.Counter();cpu=run['cpu']
 for block in (p/'frames.txt').read_text().split('\n\n'):
  lines=block.splitlines()
  if not lines:continue
  m=re.match(r'^(\d+\.\d+):\s+(\d+)',lines[0])
  if not m:raise ValueError(lines[0])
  if not cpu['startMonotonic']<=float(m[1])<=cpu['endMonotonic']:continue
  samples+=1;period=int(m[2]);cycles+=period
  names=[resolve(int(l.split()[0],16)) for l in lines[1:] if l.strip()]
  for name in ('ReachableHandValue::Calculate','CalculateReachableHandPotential','CardChoiceSupport::CardValue','BuildProjectedShuffleOrder','::GetEnergyCostWithModifiers','::GetStarCostWithModifiers','CardIsPlayableMirrors::Invoke','::ShouldPlay','::CanPlayCard','CombatPredictionSimulator::CanPlay','BranchCardValue','::ProjectHpAfterThreat','::EffectiveEnemyHp','::GetCoverageSummary'):
   if any(name in n for n in names):counter[name]+=period
 assert samples==cpu['includedSamples'] and cycles==cpu['estimatedCycles']
 item={'root':run['scene'],'samples':samples,'cycles':cycles,'inclusive':{k:{'cycles':v,'percent':100*v/cycles} for k,v in counter.items()}}
 out.append(item);print(json.dumps(item))
Path('.local/tool-tasks/state-evaluation-query-cost-20261006/query-cpu-detail.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'Reparse of existing two complete production request traces. Inclusive overlap; not unique savings, counts or performance acceptance. Inlining can hide methods.','priorEvidence':'docs/performance/unresolved-roots-cpu-20261006.json','results':out},indent=2)+'\n')

from pathlib import Path

host=base/'.local/tool-tasks/intrinsic-card-value-20261006/updated-harness/OfflineSearchHarness.dll'

results=[]
for scene in ['dev-00-ironclad-elite','dev-10-ironclad-monster']:
 out=task/('observer-'+scene);out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 cmd=['dotnet',str(host),'--request',str(roots/(scene+'.json')),'--label','smart-cost-proof-'+scene,'--out',str(out),'--profile','VeryHigh','--dop','16','--budget-ms','300000','--search-mode','Coordinator','--nodes','500000','--beam','135','--card-branches','72','--pile-branches','42','--hand-branches','54','--enable-no-gc-region','--no-gc-region-budget-gigabytes','16','--use-portfolio','--production-budget']
 env=os.environ.copy();env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL']=str(dll)
 plan={'scene':scene,'command':cmd,'diagnosticOnly':True,'outerTimeoutSeconds':120,'dllSha256':hashlib.sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
 (out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2)+'\n')
 start=time.monotonic()

   process.kill();process.wait();code=process.returncode;status='TimeoutNoRetry'
 result={'scene':scene,'status':status,'exitCode':code,'diagnosticWallSeconds':time.monotonic()-start,'out':str(out)}
 results.append(result);(task/'observer-run-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
